/* @jsxRuntime classic */ import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useContext, createContext, useRef, useMemo } from 'react'; import { supabase } from './lib/supabase'; import VoiceLoanApp from './VoiceLoanApp'; // (Legacy MortgageDripCampaign component removed in Phase 3 — superseded by unified Drip Campaigns system) import LeadPipelineView from './LeadPipeline'; import { AreaChart, Area, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, PieChart, Pie, Cell } from 'recharts'; // ─── PRICING CONTEXT (Shared state across all pricing modules) ──────────────── /* ============================ THE HUB (inlined) ============================ */ const SmsAgentAdmin = (function () { // ============================================================================ // smsAgentApi.js — THE HUB backend client for SmsAgentAdmin.jsx // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- // Reads/writes go straight to Supabase and are protected by the admin-only RLS // in migration 001. d.slice(1) : d; if (ten.length === 10) return `(${ten.slice(0, 3)}) ${ten.slice(3, 6)}-${ten.slice(6)}`; return String(phone); } function toE164(raw) { if (!raw) return null; const s = String(raw).trim(); if (/^\+[1-9]\d{7,14}$/.test(s)) return s; // already E.164 const d = s.replace(/\D/g, ''); if (d.length === 10) return `+1${d}`; if (d.length === 11 && d[0] === '1') return `+${d}`; return null; // unrecognized → skipped } function parseCsv(text) { const rows = []; let row = [], field = '', inQuotes = false; for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) { const c = text[i], n = text[i + 1]; if (inQuotes) { if (c === '"' && n === '"') { field += '"'; i++; } else if (c === '"') inQuotes = false; else field += c; } else if (c === '"') inQuotes = true; else if (c === ',') { row.push(field); field = ''; } else if (c === '\r') { /* ignore */ } else if (c === '\n') { row.push(field); rows.push(row); row = []; field = ''; } else field += c; } if (field.length || row.length) { row.push(field); rows.push(row); } const headers = (rows.shift() || []).map((h) => h.trim()); const clean = rows.filter((r) => r.some((v) => (v ?? '').trim() !== '')); return { headers, rows: clean }; } const TARGET_HINTS = { phone: ['phone', 'mobile', 'cell', 'tel'], first_name: ['first name', 'firstname', 'fname', 'first', 'given'], last_name: ['last name', 'lastname', 'lname', 'last', 'surname'], email: ['email', 'e-mail'], city: ['city', 'town'], state: ['state', 'province', 'region'], postal_code: ['zip', 'postal', 'zipcode', 'postcode'], loan_type: ['loan type', 'loantype', 'product', 'program'], property_value: ['property value', 'home value', 'property'], loan_amount: ['loan amount', 'loanamount', 'amount', 'balance'], credit_band: ['credit band', 'credit', 'fico', 'score'], external_id: ['external id', 'external', 'record id', 'crm id'], consent: ['consent', 'opt in', 'optin', 'tcpa'], }; function guessMapping(headers) { const out = {}; for (const h of headers) { const key = h.toLowerCase().trim(); let match = null; for (const [target, hints] of Object.entries(TARGET_HINTS)) { if (hints.some((hint) => key === hint || key.includes(hint))) { match = target; } // ========================================================= inbox ============ async function listConversations({ status } = {}) { let query = supabase .from('sms_conversations') .select('id, lead_id, status, cta_phase, turn_count, intent, summary, ai_paused, human_owner_id, last_message_at, sms_leads(first_name, last_name, phone)') .order('last_message_at', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false });
